verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents a public API and SDKs. They cover creating and updating agents, starting sessions with streaming, chat completions, and a Python client spanning agents, sessions, MCP, skills, artifacts and teams. That is a substantial programmatic surface, but nothing claims or shows full parity with the UI. Many UI features have no documented API equivalent, and no OpenAPI spec was found to confirm coverage. Missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, API coverage for configuring triggers/schedules, connectors, human-in-the-loop approvals, performance/analytics and access roles, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
